definition: Petar Veličković is the creator of Graph Attention Networks (GAT) and Geometric Deep Learning.
details: Invented Graph Attention Networks, neural algorithmic reasoning, and co-authored the Geometric Deep Learning blueprint at Google DeepMind.

explainer.lead: Petar Veličković is a research scientist. His work spans machine learning and deep learning.

timeline.what: Doctor of Philosophy, University of Cambridge
